steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Add one available QA vendor to satisfy the participant requirement.
Open the Schedule Event drawer from the footer schedule control.
Attempt to save with the start date intentionally left empty.
Verify that the missing date/start-time field is marked required.
